dedupe_keys.name: pymodes mode s and ads b message decoder

description: pyModeS is a fast Python decoder for Mode S and ADS-B messages broadcast by aircraft. Version 3 is a ground-up rewrite with a single decode function that returns every decodable field in one pass: identification and call sign, airborne and surface position through CPR pair resolution, airborne velocity, and Comm-B registers such as data link capability and heading and speed. It decodes single messages, batches with timestamps, and streams through a stateful PipeDecoder that keeps per-aircraft state, matches position pairs and evicts stale aircraft; surface positions use an airport reference from a shipped airport database. Coverage is any receiver data, such as recordings from the OpenSky Network. Access: free on PyPI and GitHub under the GNU General Public License version 3; release 3.6.0 was uploaded on 16 July 2026 and needs Python 3.11 or later. Caveats: it decodes raw messages only, so trajectories still need cleaning and assembly, and some Comm-B registers are ambiguous. It supports building aircraft trajectories for airspace capacity, network flow and emissions studies. It complements the OpenSky Network, the traffic library and OpenAP catalogued here.
